title: CT scans of BYD car parts
summary: Lumafield, an industrial CT scanning company, featured BYD (Build Your Dreams) electric vehicle parts as their 'scan of the month', using X-ray computed tomography to reveal internal structures and manufacturing details of EV components non-destructively.
problem_solved: Reveals internal construction details and manufacturing quality of EV components without destructive disassembly.
why_valuable: Provides unprecedented insight into EV battery architecture, motor components, and overall build quality of Chinese electric vehicles for quality inspection and competitive analysis.
